title: A conformance corpus file
description: The shape of one file under tests/corpus. Every corpus file is checked against this schema, by both validators.

group.description: The group's title in the test report; a topic, not a slug.

description.description: What this group of cases is about, and why the area is worth pinning.

$comment: Closed so a mistyped key is reported rather than ignored.

case.title: One case: an input, an invocation, and the behavior it records

allOf.$comment: Exactly one form of each document. A case carrying both is rejected rather than resolved silently.

name.description: The claim the case makes, as an independent clause. This is the describe title in the report and what --grep selects on.

description.description: Why the claim is worth asserting, when the claim does not already say it. Omitted rather than made to restate the name.

schema.description: The schema, as inline JSON. Any JSON value: a boolean is a schema too.

schemaText.description: The schema as raw text, for a case whose schema must not be valid JSON.

instance.description: The instance, as inline JSON. Any JSON value.

instanceText.description: The instance as raw text. Required for anything a JSON value cannot carry -- a duplicate member name, or a document that does not parse.

refs.description: Additional schemas, each passed as one --ref, in order.

items.$comment: A ref is inline JSON like schema, or a string when it must be raw text.

args.description: Extra flags appended to the usual --schema/--instance invocation.

argv.description: The whole argument list instead, for a case about the argument parser. {schema} and {instance} stand in for the materialized paths.

omit.description: Documents to leave unwritten -- the missing-file cases.

makeDirectory.description: Documents to create as a directory instead of a file.

identicalMessages.description: Assert both validators emit the same lines word for word. Set only where the wrappers generate the text rather than the libraries.

case.$comment: Closed so a mistyped key is reported rather than ignored.

expectation.title: What a run of this case produces
expectation.description: What the case produced when it was last run. Each field is a single value when the two validators agree, or an object keyed by validator when they do not.

stderrContains.description: A substring each validator's stderr must contain. Matched loosely because diagnostics quote paths and library prose.

exitStatus.description: 0 the instance is valid, 1 it is invalid, 2 the run could not be made to happen as asked.

verdictLines.description: stdout as lines, without trailing newline. Empty when the run printed nothing.

defect.title: Behavior the case pins as current and wrong
defect.description: Why the behavior this case records is wrong, and what it should become.

summary.description: What is wrong, stated as a fact about the wrappers.

divergent.description: Set when the defect makes the two validators disagree, which suspends this case's cross-validator check. Omitted for a defect they share, which leaves them agreeing.
